sources.entry: Kimai - Track work time and print out a summary of your activities on demand. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Kimai is a free, open-source, self-hostable time-tracking application for projects, with invoicing, reporting, and a JSON API.
summary.what_it_does: Kimai tracks project work time for freelancers and companies with many users. It offers multi-timer and punch-in/punch-out modes, tagging, and search and filtering. It supports user, customer, and project-specific rates, plus money and time budgets. Reporting includes data exports, invoicing, and a JSON API. Authentication can use SAML, LDAP, or a database, with TOTP two-factor authentication and customizable role and team permissions. The README also mentions multi-timezone and multi-language support (over 30 translations), plugin support, and a paid and free plugin marketplace.
use_cases: track time spent on client projects
set hourly rates per user, customer, or project
export time data and build reports
manage team time tracking with roles and permissions
punch in and out of work shifts
how_to_run: Install PHP 8.2+ with the extensions gd, intl, json, mbstring, pdo, tokenizer, xml, xsl, zip
Serve Kimai from a webserver on its own subdomain (subdirectory is not supported)
Use the documented Docker, Docker-Compose, Git/Composer, or other on-premise install options
Alternatively, use the hosted Cloud version
See the Update Kimai and UPGRADING guides for version upgrades
notable: Multi-timer and punch-in/punch-out time tracking modes
Invoicing, data exports, and advanced reporting
SAML, LDAP, database authentication with TOTP 2FA
Plugin system with a marketplace of paid and free plugins
caveats: Requires a dedicated subdomain; subdirectory hosting is not supported
Needs PHP extensions and a supported MariaDB or MySQL database
